Sales results by format: 'Hidakaya' had 440 stores, with a year-on-year ratio of 111.9%; 'Yakitori Hidaka' had 27 stores, with a year-on-year ratio of 112.2%; and other formats had 5 stores, with a year-on-year ratio of 114.2%. Stores are concentrated in the Kanto region's 1 metropolis and 6 prefectures, including 210 in Tokyo, 109 in Saitama, 73 in Kanagawa and 59 in Chiba. The number of employees is 1,088, and the average number of temporary employees is 4,327.

entries.7a1e65c673b22c8a: The medium-term management plan 'Hiday Challenge' was formulated in April 2025 and is being pursued on a rolling basis, reviewed every year to respond quickly to changes in the business environment. Key priorities are store strategy, including expanding stores in northern Kanto and accelerating openings in unopened areas and along roadsides; expanding domestic share and entering overseas markets through the FC business; considering alliances and M&A; strengthening recruitment and personnel development; reducing labor and improving store operating efficiency through DX; developing new products and expanding sales channels; strengthening branding; and promoting sustainability initiatives. The company aims to contribute to regional revitalization as social infrastructure through expanding its store network.

entries.b9f67f50f99ee854: This is a directly operated chain of Chinese-style restaurants. As of the end of February 2026, the company directly operated 472 stores across the Kanto region's 1 metropolitan area and 6 prefectures, including 210 in Tokyo, 109 in Saitama, 73 in Kanagawa, and 59 in Chiba. To improve and stabilize quality and achieve uniformity, the functions from food procurement, manufacturing of noodles, gyoza and seasonings, operational management of orders for each store, to logistics are concentrated at the Gyoda Plant in Gyoda, Saitama Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥62,252 million.
entries.c6b0b90dfbbd96db: Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥62,252 million, up 11.9% year on year, a record high for the third consecutive year. By format, 'Hidakaya,' with 440 stores, is the core of sales.
